page_title: Abendrot - Mac Screen Warmer for Night Work

summary.name: Abendrot
summary.one_liner: Abendrot is a free, open-source macOS menu-bar app that warms the whole screen around sunset to reduce blue and cyan light in the evening.
use_cases: reduce blue light during evening work
warm up external monitors at night
temporarily view true colors with a shortcut
summary.what_it_does:
Abendrot adjusts screen warmth from the macOS menu bar, showing the estimated blue-channel reduction and letting you switch between Sunset and Manual modes. It warms automatically around local sunset, using your time zone or a chosen city. It lists each connected display and lets you pick Automatic, Screen tint, or Hardware control where supported. A global shortcut can be held or toggled to return the screen temporarily to true color. The page says it has no account, analytics, or telemetry, and settings stay on the Mac.</what_it_does>
